adds.title: Executive Order by Governor Deval Patrick - Feb 17, 2011
adds.summary: On February 17, 2011, Massachusetts prohibited state government and its contractors from discriminating on the basis of gender identity or expression, extending existing protections to transgender state workers.

adds.title: H140 - Massachusetts Conversion Therapy Ban
adds.summary: Massachusetts enacted H140 banning conversion therapy, becoming the 16th state to do so.
